answer: An identity registers only by binding one non-transferable credential to a 400 POA bond, locked 120 days, 100% slashed on proven duplication. The credential works like a crystal: one facet, one identity; splitting it across clones fractures the bond and slashes every identity sharing it. A vault lists each credential hash, so anyone can check in seconds that no credential is reused. Identities start on an island of zero trust, gaining influence after six epochs. A glacier-slow join puzzle adds 4 CPU-hours per fake. 1,000 fakes cost 400,000 POA locked plus 4,000 CPU-hours.
